# ICrossChainReceiver
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/ICrossChainReceiver.sol)

**Inherits:**
IERC165

**Title:**
ICrossChainReceiver

Unified interface for receiving cross-chain operations

Replaces the separate ICrossChainAssetReceiver, ICrossChainMessageReceiver, and ICrossChainStateReadReceiver
interfaces


## Functions
### receiveOperation

Receives and processes a cross-chain operation

This is the unified entry point for all cross-chain operations

The implementation should decode encodedParams based on operationType:
- MESSAGE: BridgeTypes.RelayedMessageParams
- TRANSFER_ASSET: BridgeTypes.RelayedTransferParams
- READ_STATE: BridgeTypes.RelayedReadResponse


```solidity
function receiveOperation(BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType, bytes calldata encodedParams) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|The type of operation being delivered|
|`encodedParams`|`bytes`|Encoded operation parameters specific to the operation type|


### getSupportedOperationTypes

Returns the operation types supported by this receiver

This allows callers to discover what operations this receiver can handle


```solidity
function getSupportedOperationTypes() external view returns (BridgeTypes.OperationType[] memory supportedTypes);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`supportedTypes`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType[]`|Array of supported operation types|


### supportsInterface

Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`.

See ERC-165. Implementations must return true for ICrossChainReceiver and IERC165 selectors.


```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`interfaceId`|`bytes4`|The ERC-165 interface identifier to query.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if the interface is supported.|


## Events
### CrossChainOperationReceived
Emitted when a cross-chain operation is successfully processed


```solidity
event CrossChainOperationReceived(
    BridgeTypes.OperationType indexed operationType, bytes32 indexed operationId, uint16 indexed sourceChainId
);
```

## Errors
### UnsupportedOperationType
Thrown when an unsupported operation type is received


```solidity
error UnsupportedOperationType();
```

### Unauthorized
Thrown when the caller is not authorized to deliver operations


```solidity
error Unauthorized();
```
